name: Enaml
tagline: The operations layer for multi-site dental groups.
positioning: Enaml unifies scheduling, claims, and chair utilization across every location so DSO operators can run practices on one operational source of truth.

hero.h1: Run every dental location on one operational spine.
hero.sub: Enaml connects scheduling, claims, and chair utilization across all your practices — so regional managers stop reconciling spreadsheets and start reading one number they trust.

features.title: Chair utilization, live
features.description: See open-chair minutes by location, provider, and hour. Enaml flags the schedule gaps that quietly cost a practice tens of thousands each month.

features.title: Claims that don't stall
features.description: Automated eligibility checks and clean-claim scrubbing catch coding errors before submission, shrinking the days-in-AR your CFO reports to the board.

features.title: Cross-site scheduling
features.description: Route patients to the nearest location with capacity. Recall lists and hygiene reappointments sync across every practice in the group.

features.title: Provider credentialing
features.description: Track licenses, DEA registrations, and payer enrollments in one ledger, with renewal alerts before a provider ever drops out of network.

features.title: Standardized reporting
features.description: One production, collections, and net-revenue report format across acquired practices — regardless of the PMS each location came in on.

features.title: Integration layer
features.description: Bidirectional sync with Dentrix, Eaglesoft, and Open Dental, so your data platform stays current without manual exports.

testimonials.quote: We onboarded 41 practices onto Enaml in a quarter. For the first time our regional directors open the same dashboard and argue about the strategy, not the numbers.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

testimonials.quote: Days in AR dropped from 38 to 22 after the claims scrubbing went live. Our billing team stopped chasing rejections and started working denials that actually matter.
testimonials.name: Marcus Elliott

testimonials.quote: The chair-utilization view paid for the whole contract. We found 900 empty hygiene hours a month we didn't know we had across the Southeast region.
testimonials.name: Danielle Okafor
